title: qhf-core: Quantum-Hydrodynamic Feedback Engine and Measurement Audit on Superconducting QPUs
description: High-performance Rust engine and measurement audit coupling Gross-Pitaevskii fluid dynamics with IBM Quantum Heron superconducting processors. Documents the algebraic operator analysis, comparison of unentangled projective tracking against CNOT marginal crosstalk, and classical/randomized control arm benchmarks.
